## v0.5.38: Quieter Conversation Switching and Reliable Idle Review / 减少会话切换读取与可靠的空闲审查

- Suppress redundant memory reads during conversation switches and in hidden panels; preserve explicit refreshes, write invalidation and history recovery (#530, #534; fixes #526).
- Skip automatic review before starting children or spending attempts when session tool guards block its completion channel (#533; fixes #525).
- Add opt-in persistent review quotas and cooling time, and align Source tools with live component lifecycle (#531, #532).
- Improve touch targets and narrow panels; hide explicitly disabled Source tabs (#520, #528, #529).
- Fix ByteRover npm CLI startup on Windows (#527).

- 减少会话切换及隐藏面板的冗余记忆读取，保留显式刷新、写入失效与历史恢复（#530、#534；修复 #526）。
- 会话工具守卫阻止完成通道时，在启动子 Agent 或消耗次数前跳过自动审查（#533；修复 #525）。
- 增加可选的持久化审查配额与冷却时间，并让 Source 工具跟随活动组件生命周期（#531、#532）。
- 改进触控点击区域与窄面板，隐藏明确关闭的 Source 标签（#520、#528、#529）。
- 修复 Windows 上 ByteRover npm CLI 的启动（#527）。

Starter **0.5.38**, Documents **0.5.12**, Memory Spaces **0.5.25**, Runtime **0.5.17**, Skills **0.5.5**, ByteRover **0.5.6**; thirteen other components retain their versions. Acceptance covers DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**, **0.2.1-rc.2** and **0.2.1-rc.3**. Existing memories need no migration.

Starter **0.5.38**、Documents **0.5.12**、Memory Spaces **0.5.25**、Runtime **0.5.17**、Skills **0.5.5**、ByteRover **0.5.6**，其余十三个组件保持原版本。验收覆盖 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**、**0.2.1-rc.2** 与 **0.2.1-rc.3**。现有记忆无需迁移。

From v0.5.37, use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH. / 从 v0.5.37 升级，使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，随后重启 DSH。
